patterns.note: The primary content area is a full-bleed, vertically stacked image gallery, with minimal UI elements fixed to the edges of the viewport.
All textual UI elements (navigation, labels, counters) use an extremely small, uppercase, sans-serif font with generous letter spacing.
The UI uses a stark black and white palette, allowing the rich and diverse colors of the product photography to dominate the visual experience.
As the user scrolls, new full-width images slide vertically into the main viewport, while the navigation links, scroll counter, and 'BACK TO TOP' link remain fixed in their positions.
Each 'section' of the page is dedicated entirely to a single, high-resolution product photograph, filling the majority of the screen.

technique_notes: The site employs a fixed header navigation and a fixed 'back to top' link, along with a dynamic scroll progress counter, positioned at the extreme edges of the viewport. The main content area consists of a series of full-width images that scroll vertically, replacing each other in the primary viewing area without any complex transitions or parallax effects.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very flat, all text is small and uppercase, with navigation items being only slightly larger than the scroll counter.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with UI elements pushed to the extreme edges, leaving the center clear for immersive imagery.

standout: The design's extreme restraint and almost complete removal of traditional content and navigation elements create an immersive, uninterrupted visual experience focused solely on high-quality product photography. It functions as a pure visual portfolio.
